name: Hall of Arms
summary: Dwarven warriors and hunters train at the Hall of Arms in Ironforge’s Military Ward. Its command staff oversees the city’s forces, while steam tanks and flying machines are prepared for battle.

sections.title: Heart of the Mountain's Arsenal
sections.body: The Hall of Arms commands Ironforge’s armed forces from the southeastern corner of the Military Ward. Warriors and hunters train there under veteran instructors, while the facility stores and stages machines of war. Steam tanks are assembled and maintained on site for Alliance battlefields. Gyrocopters and flying machines travel up industrial conveyor belts, then launch through shafts in the cavern ceiling toward the Ironforge Airfield above.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Hall of Arms?
faq.answer: The Hall of Arms is the command center for Ironforge’s military forces. It trains warriors and hunters, and stores, maintains, and deploys war machines such as steam tanks and gyrocopters.

faq.q: Where do the flying machines launched from the ceiling go?
faq.answer: Conveyor systems raise the flying machines through shafts in the ceiling and send them directly to the Ironforge Airfield on the mountain slopes above. This chimney is one of the only direct surface exits from the mountain besides the main gates.

faq.q: Who can I find training inside the Hall?
faq.answer: Warrior and hunter instructors train inside the Hall of Arms. Alliance battlemasters also organize troop movements and enlistments for battlefronts across the continent.

faq.q: Where is the Hall of Arms located?
aliases: how to get to hall of arms
faq.answer: The Hall of Arms stands in Ironforge’s southeastern quadrant, at the back of the Military Ward.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see Khaz Modan’s union of martial discipline and mechanical ingenuity in the Hall of Arms, where tanks and aerial squadrons protect the mountain kingdom.
As a warrior, you can find dwarven armsmen and veterans gathering at the Hall of Arms for instruction and battlemaster leadership.
